source: Existing team worksheet (Q01-Q11), Sanket GenAI skill (S08), plus new proposed role-specific questions informed by Cloudera Education learning-path topics.
questionBankStatus: Existing team questions retained; all newly added questions are drafts requiring Sanket/Maria/SME content validation before customer release.

Data Engineer.label: Data Engineering
Data Engineer.description: CDP, NiFi, Kafka, Iceberg, Spark, Airflow, data quality, performance, and incremental pipelines

Data Ops.label: Data Operations
Data Ops.description: CDP, NiFi operations, Kafka operations, streaming reliability, schemas, and incident response

Data Analyst.label: Data Analytics
Data Analyst.description: CDP, SQL, Impala/Hive, data modeling, visualization, query tuning, and data quality

ML Engineer.label: Machine Learning
ML Engineer.description: CDP, ML fundamentals, Cloudera AI, MLOps, deployment, RAG, and GenAI

App Developer.label: Application Development
App Developer.description: CDP, HBase, NoSQL APIs, application security, event-driven integration, and deployment

Administrator.label: Administration
Administrator.description: CDP, Cloudera Manager, authentication, capacity, recovery, and incident operations

Architect.label: Architecture
Architect.description: CDP, hybrid and multicloud architecture, lakehouse, security, resilience, and edge-to-AI

Data Governance.label: Data Governance
Data Governance.description: CDP, catalog, Ranger policies, lineage, classification, audits, and stewardship

questions.question: How familiar are you with Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) fundamentals & concepts?

levels.1: I understand the basic purpose and terminology of CDP.
